title: Ticket to Ride Legacy: Legends of the West
subtitle: The 12-Game Transcontinental Railway Campaign
tagline: Forge your railroad empire and conquer the American frontier across 12 legacy rounds.
loreSummary: You are a 19th-century railway entrepreneur seeking fortune and glory in a rapidly expanding continent. Across 12 narrative rounds, you will unlock regional frontier boxes, establish custom routes, face unexpected events, and build a lasting railroad dynasty.
keyFeatures: Unlockable regional frontier boxes with new mechanics and board extensions
Permanent track stickers, custom postcards, and financial ledger scoring
Post-campaign replayability with a personalized, fully expanded map

ttr_legacy_full_campaign.name: Full Transcontinental Campaign (12 Games)
ttr_legacy_full_campaign.description: The complete 12-game legacy experience spanning all frontier boxes, narrative chapters, and board expansions.

ttr_legacy_frontier_half.name: First Half: Plains & Frontier (6 Games)
ttr_legacy_frontier_half.description: Play through the first 6 games covering early rail networks and initial regional expansion.

ttr_legacy_campaign_plus_epilogue.name: Complete Campaign & Post-Game Eras (16 Games)
ttr_legacy_campaign_plus_epilogue.description: The full 12-game legacy campaign plus 4 post-campaign sessions played on your completed, customized map.

milestones.title: Across the Great Plains
milestones.description: Open the first frontier box, lay tracks across the central prairie, and establish the primary hub.

milestones.title: Conquering the Rockies
milestones.description: Bore tunnels and construct trestles through the mountain barriers to connect western settlements.

milestones.title: Southwestern Spur
milestones.description: Expand the network across arid deserts to reach burgeoning boomtowns and Pacific ports.

milestones.title: The Golden Spike
milestones.description: Drive the golden spike uniting North America from sea to shining sea and crown the greatest railway baron.
